Title: UmbraDesktop
Description: An OS-style windowed desktop for the Umbraco backoffice. Open content, media, settings and other sections as real draggable, resizable windows and work in several of them side by side. Includes a grouped app launcher with pinnable apps, a taskbar, per-user wallpapers, and five chrome themes: the Umbraco look, a retro Umbraco 4, macOS, Windows 11 and Windows 98. Themes restyle the desktop only, never the backoffice inside a window, and adding one of your own is a folder of CSS.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features.

Screenshots.Caption: Content and media open as separate windows, side by side, with the taskbar below.
The launcher: your pinned apps at the top, everything else grouped by what it does.
The macOS theme: traffic lights on every title bar, a floating dock, and the backoffice in dark mode.
The Windows 98 theme: grey chrome, navy title bars, and the launcher as a Start menu.
The way in: the desktop icon in the backoffice header, between Help and your avatar.
